desc: USB host storage is blocked on VBUS, and this ticket enumerates exactly what is missing. Ticket 170 already showed the right-port smoke reached xHCI ROOT HUBS but no child device because a bus-powered stick has no VBUS; apple,force-host-mode deliberately bypasses the CD321x PD controller that owns CC detection, data/power role and VBUS sourcing. NOTE a self-powered device does NOT avoid this: USB forbids a device applying its D+ pull-up before it sees VBUS, so an iPhone or powered SSD still will not attach. FINDINGS (config-macsmc-hid-type-fix-trackpad-nbcon-ppp-cpufreq): dwc3, xHCI and USB_ROLE_SWITCH are =y; but CONFIG_TYPEC=m, CONFIG_TYPEC_TPS6598X=m (the cd321x driver) and CONFIG_I2C_APPLE=m are MODULES, and our boot images have no module loading; and CONFIG_PHY_APPLE_ATC is NOT SET AT ALL. Worse for the USB3 path: drivers/phy/apple/atc.c matches ONLY apple,t8103-atcphy, with zero occurrences of t602x/t6020/t8112 -- the Apple Type-C PHY driver does not support this SoC yet. PHY_APPLE_ATC also depends on TYPEC, so TYPEC must be built in first. PLAN, cheapest first: (1) config-only TYPEC=y, TYPEC_TPS6598X=y, I2C_APPLE=y -- no new code or DT, just makes the PD controller bindable; (2) locate the CD321x on T6040 from the ADT (which I2C controller, address, interrupt) -- ADT-derived only, never copied from another SoC; (3) compose a right-port connector node (i2c + apple,cd321x + connector power-role/data-role) and test whether the PD driver sources VBUS without any HPM 4CC poking, which is the entire point of 170's redirect and keeps us out of the deny-by-default SPMI path; (4) only then re-run 108 (enumeration) and 109 (read-only block). USB2-only (ticket 188's byte-reproducible candidate) is the cheapest credible route to a flash drive and avoids atcphy entirely, but still needs VBUS. Rig is serialized for ticket 230, so this is offline work. CORRECTION 2026-08-04, same day, before anything was built: the ADT hunt REFUTED the CD321x/I2C plan. j614s-full-20260728.adt shows FOUR PD controllers, all SPMI: hpm0/hpm1 under nub-spmi-a0 and hpm2/hpm5 under nub-spmi-a1, every one with compatible 'usbc,sn201202x,spmi'. Not i2c, not cd321x. drivers/usb/typec/tipd/core.c binds apple,cd321x but is an I2C driver (includes linux/i2c.h, i2c_protocol) with no SPMI transport, and 'grep -rl sn201202x drivers/' returns NOTHING -- there is no driver for this part in the tree. The SPMI bus itself is supported (drivers/spmi/spmi-apple-controller.c); only the client is missing. Ticket 170's redirect was derived from M1/M2 where the PD controller sits on I2C, and that premise does not hold on M4 Pro. REVISED OPTIONS: (1) write an SPMI client -- a tipd SPMI transport or a small dedicated driver -- which is new driver code and the honest cost of USB host here; (2) use the already-RE'd 4CC sequence over SPMI, which is fast but deny-by-default and needs a fresh CJ exception, and note ticket 096 recorded R3 as swapping the DATA role only, so it never produced VBUS and is not a shortcut; (3) no hardware shortcut exists, since a self-powered device still may not assert D+ before it sees VBUS. CONFIG: only TYPEC=y survives (prerequisite for the Type-C class and for PHY_APPLE_ATC, which depends on TYPEC); TYPEC_TPS6598X=y and I2C_APPLE=y were justified solely by the refuted I2C path. DRIVER WRITTEN 2026-08-04 (fable), option (1) chosen: an SPMI transport added to drivers/usb/typec/tipd/. Deliverable patches/0001-usb-typec-tps6598x-add-SPMI-transport-for-T6040-SN20.patch -- factors tps6598x_probe_common(dev,regmap,irq,data)/tps6598x_remove_common out of the I2C probe, adds tipd/spmi.c (spmi_driver on usbc,sn201202x,spmi binding cd321x_data, compiled into the same tps6598x module), new Kconfig TYPEC_TPS6598X_SPMI, kbuild switch T6040_TYPEC_PD=1. KEY CORRECTION to the stated plan: devm_regmap_init_spmi_ext is a FLAT map (regmap reg N -> spmi_ext_register_read N) and does NOT work -- the SN201202x is PAGED (select logical reg via SPMI reg0 zero-write + BIT(7) busy poll, then payload through a 16-byte-chunked auto-incrementing window at SPMI reg 0x20), proven by m1n1's live R2 path AND Apple's own AppleHPMARMSPMI::readRegs. So spmi.c provides a custom regmap_bus doing select-then-window; core.c keeps seeing the flat 8-bit map. Compiles + links =y (WIFI+PCIE+T6040_TYPEC_PD build: core.o+spmi.o built, Image carries tps6598x-spmi + usbc,sn201202x,spmi). Probe stays in the sanctioned envelope (WAKEUP + SSPS-to-S0 + reads; NO role-swap 4CC -- those are in dr_set/pr_set, sysfs-only). REMAINING: independent exact-source review, a DT connector node (ADT-derived SID/interrupts, ticket 170), CJ sign-off, attended rig run. NOTE a functional image needs SPMI_APPLE=y which conflicts with the SD_GL9755 SD-diag profile (guarded as a hard error in kbuild) -- the USB-host integration image will need an initramfs root, not the SD-diag profile.
